app.name: Food Picker
app.tagline: Stop arguing about where to eat.
lang.label: Language
home.hello: Two people, one phone, zero arguments.
home.intro: Tell us where you are, answer yes or no for each cuisine, and we pick great places nearby.
offline.banner: You are offline. Saved data still works; searching for places needs a connection.
install.title: Install Food Picker
install.body: Add it to your home screen to open it like an app.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
setup.title: Let’s set things up
setup.postcode.invalid: That postcode doesn’t look right. Example: {example}
setup.mode: How do you want to eat?
discover.title: Finding great places
discover.done.title: Here’s what’s nearby
discover.summary: {qualified} places rated {rating}+ with at least {reviews} reviews
discover.found: {found} found in total · {unknown} with an unknown cuisine · {calls} API calls
discover.sparse: Only {n} places qualify. Try a bigger radius for more choice.
discover.sparse.none: No places qualify in this area. Try a bigger radius or another postcode.
discover.specific.hint: Dense areas can return incomplete results. This makes one extra search.
discover.specific.none: No new places found for that cuisine.
discover.error.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
discover.error.postcode_not_found: We couldn’t find that postcode. Check it and try again.
discover.error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
discover.error.locked: Too many wrong passcodes. Try again in 15 minutes.
discover.error.daily_cap: The daily search limit has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
discover.error.server_not_configured: The server isn’t configured yet (missing API key or passcode).
passcode.title: Enter the app passcode
passcode.hint: This app uses its owner’s Google API key, so searches are protected by a passcode.
passcode.label: Passcode
